# Barry Plant Real Estate

> > Barry Plant is a full-service real estate agency across Victoria and South Australia offering property sales, rentals, management, and market insights through 70+ office locations.

Barry Plant operates as a comprehensive real estate platform serving Melbourne, regional Victoria, and Adelaide with extensive property listings, professional agents, and digital tools for buyers, sellers, and investors. The agency maintains one of Australia's largest databases of sold properties and offers specialized services including property management, commercial real estate, and off-the-plan developments.
